item.title: Robinhood Ventures Fund II Targets $200 Million to Open Early-Stage Deals to Retail Investors
item.summary: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev launched the roadshow for Robinhood Ventures Fund II, a publicly traded BDC targeting $200 million at $25/share to give retail investors access to early-stage private companies, with IPO set for August 13, 2026.
